package main

// The real stored 2.1 document as a scenario (pkg/intentcert/bind_v21_real_test.go: loadReal21, factsOf, g0g1), and small helpers.

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strings"

	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/accumulate-lite-client-2/liteclient/proof/govvote"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/intentcert"
	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/proof"
	proofv2 "github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/proof/v2"
	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/pkg/url"
	"gitlab.com/accumulatenetwork/accumulate/protocol"
)

func bigOne() *big.Int { return big.NewInt(1) }

func stackNow() []byte { return debug.Stack() }

type real21 struct {
	ev  *proofv2.Evidence
	rep *proofv2.Report
}

func loadReal21(validator string) (real21, error) {
	dir := filepath.Join(validator, "pkg", "proof", "v2", "testdata", "xpartition3", "real-bvn1-billing-receipts")
	evRaw, err := readDoc(filepath.Join(dir, "evidence21.json.gz"))
	if err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	ev := new(proofv2.Evidence)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(evRaw, ev); err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	arRaw, err := readDoc(filepath.Join(dir, "archive.json.gz"))
	if err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	ar, err := proofv2.UnmarshalArchive(arRaw)
	if err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(validator, "pkg", "proof", "testdata", "incarnation", "kermit.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	inc := new(proof.IncarnationEvidence)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, inc); err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	ir, err := inc.Verify()
	if err != nil {
		return real21{}, err
	}
	var pin [32]byte
	b, _ := hex.DecodeString(kermitPin)
	copy(pin[:], b)
	rep, err := proofv2.Verify21FromGenesis(ev, ar, ir.Inputs, pin)
	if err != nil {
		return real21{}, fmt.Errorf("the stored real document does not verify: %w", err)
	}
	return real21{ev: ev, rep: rep}, nil
}

func (r real21) voteEvidence() (*govvote.Evidence, string, error) {
	ev := &govvote.Evidence{Version: govvote.EvidenceVersion, Account: r.ev.Account, Transaction: r.ev.Transaction}
	for _, a := range r.rep.Pages {
		if strings.EqualFold(a.GetUrl().String(), r.ev.Account) {
			fa, ok := a.(protocol.FullAccount)
			if !ok {
				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("the principal is %T", a)
			}
			for _, e := range fa.GetAuth().Authorities {
				ev.Authorities = append(ev.Authorities, govvote.AccountAuthority{URL: e.Url.String(), Disabled: e.Disabled})
			}
		}
	}
	for _, v := range r.ev.Votes {
		for _, h := range append(append([]proofv2.VoteHop(nil), v.Hops...), v.Counted...) {
			ev.Signatures = append(ev.Signatures, govvote.SignatureEvidence{Fact: govvote.SigFact{ID: h.Message, Signer: h.Page, Block: int64(h.Block)}, Signature: h.Signature})
		}
		ev.Votes = append(ev.Votes, govvote.VoteEvidence{Fact: govvote.RecordedVote{ID: v.Message, Authority: v.Authority, Origin: v.Origin, Block: int64(r.rep.AnchorBlock)}})
	}
	var page string
	for _, p := range r.rep.Proven {
		for _, d := range p.Declared {
			if d == proofv2.RoleCertifiedKeyPage {
				page = p.URL
			}
		}
	}
	if page == "" {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("the real document records no certified key page")
	}
	return ev, page, nil
}

func realIntentBase(validator string) (*RootCase, error) {
	r, err := loadReal21(validator)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	ve, page, err := r.voteEvidence()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	facts, err := intentcert.GoverningFactsFromVoteEvidence(ve)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(page)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	bk, ok := u.Parent()
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s has no book", page)
	}
	g0 := &proof.G0Result{EntryHashExec: hx(r.rep.TxHash), ExecWitness: hx(r.rep.AnchorRootChainAnchor), ExecMBI: int64(r.rep.AnchorBlock)}
	g0.Receipt.Start = g0.EntryHashExec
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(ve)
	return caseOf(r.rep, r.ev, g0, page, page, bk.String(), facts, raw, hashesOf(60), "root"), nil
}
